sloka: चित्तनाशाद्विपद्यन्ते सर्वाण्येवेन्द्रियाणि मे ।क्षिणस्नेहस्य दीपस्य सम्सक्ता रश्मयो यथा ॥२-६४-७४॥
transliteration: cittanāśādvipadyante sarvāṇyevendriyāṇi me ।kṣiṇasnehasya dīpasya samsaktā raśmayo yathā ॥2-64-74॥

translations.english: With the loss of my mental faculty, all the sense organs are giving way, like the rays of the lamp giving way together when the oil is exhausted.
